defect: The new depth blit binds currentRenderVfb_->fbo for reading without checking it is non-zero, but in non-buffered mode the fbo is destroyed and set to 0, so the blit crashes.
reason: The fix adds exactly the missing currentRenderVfb_->fbo != NULL check to the condition this change added, and the diff itself shows the non-buffered branch zeroing vfb->fbo.

defect: The change adds an unterminated #ifdef USE_DIRECTX around the NullGpu/SoftGpu includes and an unconditional new DIRECTX9_GPU() whose header is only included under USE_DIRECTX, breaking the build.
reason: The fix removes the stray #ifdef and guards the GPU_DIRECTX9 case with USE_DIRECTX, both repairing lines this change added; the unbalanced preprocessor lines are visible in the diff.

defect: The new log message calls t->GetTypeName() inside the branch taken when t == nullptr, dereferencing a null pointer.
reason: The fix guards exactly this added argument with t ? ... : "null", and the null dereference is evident from the condition on the same lines.

defect: The change moves #include <signal.h> from IOS/MIPS into the x86 branch, while kill() and SIGINT are used in the non-x86 branch, so IOS/MIPS (and other non-x86 builds) lose the declarations.
reason: The fix moves the include into the else branch where Crash() uses kill/SIGINT; the mismatch is visible in the changed lines.

defect: In PerformReadback the two backbuffer TransitionImageLayout2 calls pass (aspect, 0, 1) instead of (0, 1, aspect), so the mip/level arguments are wrong and 0 mips are transitioned.
reason: The fix reorders exactly these arguments added by the change, and the other calls in the same diff use the correct 0, 1, aspect order.

defect: Sampler uniforms are set with glUniform1d (a double uniform setter) instead of glUniform1i, so the tex/pal samplers are not bound to units 0/1.
reason: The fix replaces glUniform1d with glUniform1i on lines this new file added; the wrong setter for a sampler is visible in the diff.

defect: skipWrap is initialised to true, so on the first line every word is treated as one character wide and the first line wraps wrongly.
reason: The fix changes only this added initialiser to false; a reviewer reading the new logic can see the first line starts in skip-wrap mode.

defect: The change wires a new Int_VRexp2 interpreter to the tableVFPU7 slot 24 encoding, which is actually vuc2i, so that opcode is executed as a reciprocal exponent instead of a conversion.
reason: The fix deletes Int_VRexp2, moves vrexp2 to its real VV2Op case 28 and maps slot 24 to vuc2i/Int_Vx2i, repairing the mis-decoded opcode this change introduced; seeing it needs MIPSTables.cpp and the VFPU encoding.

defect: GetGestureInfo zeroes the output with memset(info, 0, sizeof(info)), where info is a pointer parameter, so only 4 or 8 bytes instead of 16 are cleared.
reason: The fix replaces sizeof(info) with sizeof(float) * 4 in the line this change added; sizeof on an array parameter is a classic diff-visible bug.

defect: The new legacy_touch_mapping maps PAD_BUTTON_BACK instead of PAD_BUTTON_SELECT to CTRL_SELECT (and touch buttons now only reach fakeInputState), so the on-screen Select and special touch buttons break.
reason: The fix changes PAD_BUTTON_BACK back to PAD_BUTTON_SELECT and copies fakeInputState.pad_buttons into input, repairing touch buttons this change broke; the old mapping with PAD_BUTTON_SELECT is visible in the removed lines.

defect: The rewritten if condition is missing a closing parenthesis, so CwCheat.cpp does not compile.
reason: The fix only adds the missing ')' to the line this change edited; the unbalanced parentheses are visible in the diff.

defect: Clear() deletes every saveDataList[i].texture even when it is the shared noSaveIcon->texture, and then deletes noSaveIcon->texture again, causing a double free.
reason: The fix adds the same noSaveIcon check to Clear() that this change already used in SetFileInfo/ClearFileInfo, so the sharing and double delete are visible in the diff.

defect: The new Win32 TextDrawer measures and renders with GetTextExtentPoint32/ExtTextOut, which ignore line breaks, so strings containing newlines are measured and drawn as a single line.
reason: The fix switches to DrawTextExW with \r\n conversion and a taller bitmap to repair multi-line text in the code this new file added; noticing it requires knowing that callers pass multi-line strings and how these Win32 calls treat newlines.

defect: The new 'All supported file types' filter lists the pattern *zip instead of *.zip, so it matches any name ending in 'zip' rather than .zip files.
reason: The fix corrects only this typo in the filter string the change added; the inconsistency with the other *.ext patterns is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix removes the whole framebuffer refcounting scheme (AddRef/Release in the render manager and in Wipe) after a refcount leak, e.g. Wipe never releasing the RENDER step's own framebuffer.
reason: Before this change Wipe released no references at all, so the leak was already there; the change only partly fixed it, and the later fix is a redesign rather than a repair of a defect this change added.

defect: The new hard-coded Enter check searches cancelKeys instead of confirmKeys before appending NKCODE_ENTER to confirmKeys, a copy-paste error that can duplicate Enter or wrongly omit it.
reason: The fix replaces cancelKeys with confirmKeys in exactly this added line; the mismatch between the searched and appended vector is visible in the diff.

defect: SetDepalTexture now ignores a null depal, so a previously bound depal texture can never be cleared and the fragment shader state is not dirtied when depal is turned off.
reason: The fix backs out exactly this condition as a wrong change; that passing nullptr becomes a no-op is visible in the diff.

defect: The new FRound, FCeil and FFloor interpreter cases write the integer result to mips->r[dest] (a GPR) instead of mips->fs[dest] (the FPU register).
reason: The fix changes those three added lines to mips->fs, matching FTrunc in the same diff, which already writes fs.

defect: EndFrame dereferences shaderInfo->isUpscalingFilter without checking that GetPostShaderInfo found the shader, crashing when sPostShaderName is not 'Off' but names no existing shader (e.g. empty in headless).
reason: The fix makes this added line null-safe; knowing that GetPostShaderInfo can return null needs its definition.

defect: The rotation PopupMultiChoice moved here uses the Graphics category (gr->GetName()) for its choice strings, whereas they are translated under Controls, so the options show untranslated.
reason: The removed GameSettingsScreen code used co->GetName() and the fix restores the Controls category on this added line; seeing it requires the other file or the language files.

defect: Registering LoadExecForKernel and SysMemForKernel in the middle of RegisterAllModules shifts the module indices stored in savestates, breaking older savestates.
reason: The fix moves these two added calls to the end of the function for savestate compatibility; that the registration order is serialized is not visible in this diff.

defect: The new mip-level offset computation (Jit_PrepareDataOffsets called for VEC_U1/VEC_V1) always multiplies by the base level's bufw, giving wrong texel offsets for mip level 1.
reason: The fix adds a level1 parameter to these newly declared functions so level 1 uses its own bufw; the wrong bufw is in SamplerX86.cpp from the same commit, not in this header.

defect: The new e_ident check rejects ELFs whose EI_CLASS is 0 (ELFCLASSNONE), so games with such headers (e.g. emulator-only patched ELFs) that loaded before no longer boot.
reason: The fix relaxes exactly this added check to log and continue for EI_CLASS 0, repairing a compatibility regression the change introduced; that such files exist is not visible from code.

defect: Comp_VDot computes dregs with GetVectorRegs(dregs, sz, vd), interpreting the single-register destination vd as a vector of size sz, so the wrong destination register is mapped.
reason: The fix changes this added call to GetVectorRegs(dregs, V_Single, vd) with dregs[1]; the mismatch with the V_Single mapping in the same new function is visible in the diff (the code was still behind DISABLE, so the defect was latent).

defect: The new ReplaceLogic description fires for clear-mode shader IDs, where the logic-op bits are 0 rather than GE_LOGIC_COPY, so the debug description is wrong.
reason: The fix adds !id.Bit(FS_BIT_CLEARMODE) to exactly this added line; knowing GE_LOGIC_COPY is non-zero requires ge_constants.h.

defect: The new check module_start_func != 0 || module_start_func != -1 is always true, so the start-function validation warnings run even when there is no start function.
reason: The fix replaces || with && in this added condition; the tautology is visible in the diff.

defect: After loading an old (version 1) savestate sasMixEvent is -1, and resaving then loading writes and restores -1 via RestoreRegisterEvent unconditionally, which crashes.
reason: The fix only calls RestoreRegisterEvent when sasMixEvent != -1; both the -1 assignment and the unconditional restore are lines this change added.

defect: The new clearFunctions() clears only the functions map, leaving visibleFunctionAddresses and strayLines referring to removed functions, so drawing dereferences functions.find(...) at end() and crashes.
reason: The fix makes clearFunctions also clear visibleFunctionAddresses and strayLines; the unchecked find in CtrlDisAsmView.cpp is needed to see the crash.

defect: A debugging 'return 0;' was added at the top of PSPSaveDialog::Init, so the save dialog never initialises or processes its parameters.
reason: The fix removes exactly this added early return ('remove hack'); the dead code after it is obvious in the diff.

defect: CheckBox::Toggled() returns the pointer toggle_ converted to bool instead of *toggle_, so every checkbox with a target shows as checked.
reason: The fix changes return toggle_ to return *toggle_ in this newly added function; the missing dereference is visible in the diff.

defect: The new BindFramebufferColor dereferences currentRenderVfb_->fbo when making the self-texturing copy, but currentRenderVfb_ is null when called from the GE debugger, causing a crash.
reason: The fix adds a currentRenderVfb_ null check to the condition of this added code; that the GE debugger calls it without a current render target needs the caller.

defect: UnsyncKey now closes the chat window on any escape-mapped key even when UIScreen already handled the key, so typing a key such as X that is bound to cancel closes the chat.
reason: The fix restores the 'only if not handled' condition (!retval) in a new key() handler; seeing that text-entry keys can also be escape keys requires the UI key-mapping code.

defect: The new warning passes the std::string logging_path to a %s format argument, which is undefined behaviour (and a compile error on some compilers).
reason: The fix adds .c_str() to this added log call; that logging_path is a std::string is declared in MIPSTracer.h.

defect: The generated GLSL line 'v_texcoord.y = 1.0f - v_texcoord.y;' uses an f-suffixed float literal, which GLSL 1.10/ES 2.0 rejects, so the shader fails to compile whenever flipV is set.
reason: The fix changes 1.0f to 1.0 in this added shader line; the invalid GLSL literal is visible in the diff given the #version 110 / ES header.

defect: logicOpSupported is set by the compile-time USING_GLES2 macro, so desktop builds running on a GLES context wrongly report logic-op support.
reason: The fix replaces the #ifndef with the runtime check !gl_extensions.IsGLES, which the same function already uses for other caps, so the inconsistency is visible in the diff.

defect: When hooking function exit, the loop finds jr ra at address + offset but writes the replacement at the function start address, so exit hooks replace the wrong instruction.
reason: The fix passes address + offset in this added loop; the unused offset is visible in the diff.

defect: The ARM64 shortcut in AnyZeroSignBit(Vec4F32) calls vmaxvq_s32 on value.v (a float32x4_t) instead of the reinterpreted ival, a type error that some compilers reject.
reason: The fix replaces value.v with ival in this added line; ival is declared just above and unused in the new branch.

defect: For arguments beyond the eighth, the stack read uses the uninitialised regval instead of reg to compute the offset, giving undefined behaviour and wrong stack reads.
reason: The fix replaces (regval - 8) with (reg - 8) in this added line; reading regval in its own initialiser is visible in the diff.

defect: On 32-bit x86 the sin/cos call uses negSin2, which is not declared at that point (and is the wrong variable), so the build fails there.
reason: The fix replaces negSin2 with negSin1 in this edited line; the x64 branch above already uses negSin1, and negSin2 is only declared later inside a nested block.

defect: The fix changes the alias check from opc > 8 to opc >= 8 so that c.sf is jitted as c.f instead of falling through to the default case.
reason: With the off-by-one, c.sf still reaches the default Comp_Generic path, which runs the interpreter (it handles sf correctly), so the result was correct and the fix only restores the intended fast path.
